info.title: binlog.cli
info.description: A CLI tool for analyzing and investigating MSBuild binlogs.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: MSBuild binlog analysis and investigation tool. Use 'batch' for multi-command sessions to avoid re-parsing the binlog on each invocation.

commands.name: search
commands.description:
Perform freetext search within a binlog file using the same search capabilities as the MSBuild Structured Log Viewer.

Query Language Syntax:
- Basic text search: Simply type words to find nodes containing that text
- Exact match: Use quotes "exact phrase" for exact string matching
- Multiple terms: Space-separated terms are AND'd together (all must match)

Node Type Filtering:
- $<type>: Filter by node type (e.g., $project, $target, $task, $csc, $rar)
- Shortcuts: $csc expands to "$task csc", $rar expands to "$task ResolveAssemblyReference"

Property and Field Matching:
- name=<value>: Match nodes where the name field equals the value
- value=<value>: Match nodes where the value field equals the value

Hierarchical Search:
- under(<query>): Find nodes under/within nodes matching the nested query
- notunder(<query>): Exclude nodes under/within nodes matching the nested query
- project(<query>): Find nodes within projects matching the nested query
- not(<query>): Exclude nodes matching the nested query

Time-based Filtering:
- start<"YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss": Nodes that started before the specified time
- start>"YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss": Nodes that started after the specified time
- end<"YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss": Nodes that ended before the specified time
- end>"YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss": Nodes that ended after the specified time

Special Properties:
- skipped=true/false: For targets, filter by whether they were skipped
- height=<number> or height=max: Filter by tree height/depth

Node Index Search:
- $<number>: Find node by its unique index (e.g., $123)

Result Enhancement:
- $time or $duration: Include timing information in results
- $start or $starttime: Include start time in results
- $end or $endtime: Include end time in results

options.name: --max
options.description: Maximum number of results to return. [default: 300]

arguments.name: BINLOG
arguments.description: Path to the MSBuild binlog file (.binlog).

arguments.name: QUERY
arguments.description: Search query. Supports $task, $project, $target type filters; name=value property matching; under(...) hierarchical filters; and more.

commands.name: list-projects
commands.description: List all projects in the loaded binary log file.

arguments.name: BINLOG
arguments.description: Path to the MSBuild binlog file (.binlog).

commands.name: expensive-projects
commands.description: Get the N most expensive projects in the loaded binary log file, aggregated at the project level with options to exclude specific targets and show exclusive vs inclusive time.

options.name: --top
options.description: Number of projects to return (default: all).

options.name: --exclude-targets
options.description: Target names to exclude from time calculations (e.g. Copy CopyFilesToOutputDirectory).

options.name: --sort-by-inclusive
options.description: Sort by inclusive time instead of exclusive time. [default: False]

arguments.name: BINLOG
arguments.description: Path to the MSBuild binlog file (.binlog).

commands.name: project-build-time

options.name: --project-id

options.name: --exclude-targets
options.description: Target names to exclude from time calculations.

arguments.name: BINLOG
arguments.description: Path to the MSBuild binlog file (.binlog).

options.name: --project-id
options.description: ID of the project (from list-projects).

arguments.name: BINLOG
arguments.description: Path to the MSBuild binlog file (.binlog).

commands.name: project-target-times
commands.description: Get all target execution times for a specific project in one call, including both inclusive and exclusive durations.

options.name: --project-id
options.description: ID of the project (from list-projects).

arguments.name: BINLOG

commands.name: expensive-targets
commands.description: Get the N most expensive targets in the loaded binary log file.

options.name: --top
options.description: Number of targets to return (default: all).

arguments.name: BINLOG
arguments.description: Path to the MSBuild binlog file (.binlog).

commands.name: search-targets
commands.description: Find all executions of a specific target across all projects (e.g., 'CoreCompile') and return their timing information.

arguments.name: BINLOG
arguments.description: Path to the MSBuild binlog file (.binlog).

arguments.name: TARGET_NAME
arguments.description: Target name to search for across all projects (case-insensitive).

commands.name: target-info
commands.description: Get some details about a specific target called in a project within the loaded binary log file. This includes the target's duration, its ID, why it was built, etc. Provide --target-name or --target-id.

options.name: --project-id
options.description: ID of the project containing the target.

options.name: --target-name
options.description: Name of the target to look up. Use either this or --target-id.

options.name: --target-id
options.description: ID of the target to look up. More efficient than --target-name.

arguments.name: BINLOG
arguments.description: Path to the MSBuild binlog file (.binlog).

commands.description: Get the N most expensive MSBuild tasks in the loaded binary log file, aggregated by task name.

options.name: --top
options.description: Number of tasks to return (default: all).

arguments.name: BINLOG

commands.description: Get detailed information about a specific MSBuild task invocation, including parameters and messages.

options.name: --target-id

arguments.name: BINLOG

commands.name: list-tasks
commands.description: List all MSBuild task invocations within a specific target, ordered by duration.

options.description: ID of the project.

options.name: --target-id

arguments.name: BINLOG

commands.description: Find all invocations of a specific MSBuild task across all projects (e.g., 'Csc', 'Copy') and return execution summary. Returns a dictionary of dictionaries — the outer keyed by project id, the inner keyed by task id.

arguments.name: TASK_NAME

options.name: --project-id
options.description: ID of the project containing the Csc task.

options.name: --target-id
options.description: ID of the target containing the Csc task.

commands.name: list-evaluations
commands.description: List all evaluations for a specific project in the loaded binary log file. You can use the list-projects command to find the project file paths. Multiple evaluations may indicate overbuilding.

options.name: --project-file
options.description: Path to the project file to list evaluations for (from list-projects).

arguments.name: BINLOG
arguments.description: Path to the MSBuild binlog file (.binlog).

commands.name: eval-global-props
commands.description: Get the global properties for a specific evaluation in the loaded binary log file. You can use the list-evaluations command to find the evaluation IDs. Global properties are what make evaluations distinct from one another within the same project.

options.name: --eval-id
options.description: Evaluation ID (from list-evaluations).

arguments.name: BINLOG
arguments.description: Path to the MSBuild binlog file (.binlog).

commands.name: eval-properties
commands.description: Get specific properties by name for a project evaluation in the loaded binary log file. You can use the list-evaluations command to find the evaluation IDs. This returns all properties (both global and non-global) matching the requested names.

options.name: --eval-id
options.description: Evaluation ID (from list-evaluations).

options.name: --names
options.description: Property names to retrieve. Returns all properties if omitted.

arguments.name: BINLOG
arguments.description: Path to the MSBuild binlog file (.binlog).

commands.name: eval-items
commands.description: Get specific items by type name for a project evaluation in the loaded binary log file. You can use the list-evaluations command to find the evaluation IDs. Returns items organized by item type (e.g., 'Compile', 'PackageReference', 'Reference').

options.name: --eval-id
options.description: Evaluation ID (from list-evaluations).

options.name: --types
options.description: Item type names to retrieve (e.g. Compile PackageReference). Returns all if omitted.

options.name: --max
options.description: Maximum items to return per item type (default: 100).

arguments.name: BINLOG
arguments.description: Path to the MSBuild binlog file (.binlog).

commands.name: timeline
commands.description: Get data about how much work specific build nodes did in a build.

arguments.name: BINLOG
arguments.description: Path to the MSBuild binlog file (.binlog).

commands.name: batch
commands.description: Load a binlog once and run multiple commands without re-parsing. Optimized for multi-command sessions — avoids the per-command binlog load overhead. Reads commands from stdin, one per line. Each command is the same as a normal CLI invocation but without the binlog path (it is injected automatically). Responds with one JSON object per line on stdout. Send 'exit' or close stdin to quit.

arguments.name: BINLOG
arguments.description: Path to the MSBuild binlog file (.binlog).
